messages:
Jana: FYI I opened a docs PR to standardize the Generate endpoint query param naming — some examples use `model`, others `model_name`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
Mike: thanks. On the server side we accept both for backwards compat, but we want the canonical parameter to be `model` (short name). Can you make the examples use `model` and add a migration note?
Tara: @Jana heads up SDK needs the param rename too — client.generate currently expects `model_name`. I can prep a small PR to accept `model` as an alias and update examples. Example snippet we'll change to:
```
# python
client.generate(model="redwood/ft-13b", prompt="Summarize...")
```
DevBot: CI check failed on the docs PR — link references old OpenAPI sample that uses `model_name`. Error: broken example in docs/openapi/generate.yaml line 72
Jana: ack. I'll update the OpenAPI sample and the migration note. Can @Mike confirm we should mark `model_name` as deprecated but keep acceptance for one release? :eyes:
Mike: yes please deprecate `model_name` in the API ref and add a one-release compatibility note. After docs updated I'll merge. :thumbsup:
Tara: I'll open the SDK PR to accept both and include changelog entry. Tagging the PRs in the docs PR when ready.
Jana: perfect — pushing an update now. I'll request review from @Tara and @Mike when done.
